[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Icons for every Artifacts sub-tab, required per sidecar ref config[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Every Artifacts sub-tab renders a colored icon beside its name. The[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]four fixed panes carry built-in marks, and every document-provider [/#D7D7AF]

[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]sidecar ref provider spec, so a sidecar repo chooses its own tab [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]icon and the strip stays readable at any terminal width.[/#D7D7AF]
